extracted.special_digivolution_condition: [DNA Digivolve] 0 from blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4 Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolve] 0 from blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4 Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] Trash the top 3 digivolution cards of all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if DNA digivolving, 2 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack until the end of your opponent's turn.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [End of Attack] If this Digimon has [Imperialdramon] in its name or the [Free] trait, gain 1 memory.
